name: Matjaž Nemec-After § 39-Am 1
title: REPORT on Parliament’s estimates of revenue and expenditure for the financial year 2026
part_text: 39a. Calls on the Bureau to revise the rules and to introduce a cooling-off period for former Members during which they cannot engage in lobbying or representational activities with the Parliament equal to the time during which Members receive a transitional allowance;
